{{Top|leg}}
'''Verdanaian "sliding hands"''' was a method of [[Unarmed combat/Legends|unarmed combat]] from the [[Verdanaia system/Legends|Verdanaia system]]. [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] [[Micah Giiett]] and [[Anoon Bondara]] taught Giett's [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Bultar Swan/Legends|Bultar Swan]] to blend it with [[Teräs Käsi/Legends|Teräs Käsi]], which created an unusual fighting style that required Swan to maintain physical contact with her opponents in order to judge their next moves.<ref name="ff">{{FactFile|111|SWA 1-2|Bultar Swan}}</ref><ref name="PotJ">''[[Power of the Jedi Sourcebook]]''</ref>
